description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per receipt - the payment buys one signed receipt verification: submit one captured 402 challenge plus the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header from its paid call and receive the decoded header fields, a per-field match report against the challenge, and the chain verdict for the header's transaction. The header's unsigned status is stated plainly - the service never upgrades an unsigned header into an attestation; the chain is ground truth.

challenge.description: The captured 402 challenge object exactly as issued by the endpoint that was paid. Processed in memory only, never stored.

paymentResponse.description: The PAYMENT-RESPONSE header value from the paid call (base64 JSON string; a raw JSON string or the decoded object are also accepted). Processed in memory only, never stored.

name: receipt_verify
